evidence.title: Illustrative fixture: intranasal delivery observation
evidence.excerpt: In the fixture study, labeled vesicle-associated signal was detected in the target compartment after intranasal administration.

evidence.title: Illustrative fixture: cargo activity assay
evidence.excerpt: The fixture assay reported a concentration-dependent change in the predefined cellular readout after exposure to the candidate preparation.

evidence.title: Illustrative fixture: short-term local tolerability
evidence.excerpt: No predefined severe local tolerability event was observed during the fixture's short observation window.

evidence.title: Illustrative fixture: study limitations
evidence.excerpt: The fixture observations used a small sample, a single short time window, and did not establish biodistribution, durability, or therapeutic efficacy.

hypotheses.statement: A predefined intranasal formulation may produce measurable target-compartment exposure under a controlled biodistribution study.
hypotheses.rationale: The fixture delivery signal supports testing exposure, while its limitations preclude an efficacy conclusion.
hypotheses.test_plan: Run a controlled, time-resolved biodistribution study with predefined acceptance criteria.

decisions.question: Should SGL-001 advance to a controlled biodistribution experiment?
decisions.outcome: Propose a controlled biodistribution experiment before any efficacy-stage decision.
decisions.rationale: The fixture supports further measurement but explicitly does not establish biodistribution or efficacy.
